name: quartetlab
description: Interactive bivariate dataset synthesizer, exact-moment solver, regression diagnostic workbench, and classroom assessment studio for GitHub Pages.

scripts.verify: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python' : 'python3'; process.exit(spawnSync(py, ['tests/verify-build.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 0);"
scripts.lint:docs: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python' : 'python3'; const files = ['README.md', 'docs/RESEARCH.md', 'docs/ARCHITECTURE.md', 'docs/PRIVACY.md', 'docs/LAUNCH_PLAN.md']; for (const f of files) { const res = spawnSync(py, ['scripts/prose_linter.py', f], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (res.status !== 0) process.exit(res.status); }"
scripts.serve: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python' : 'python3'; spawnSync(py, ['-m', 'http.server', '8080'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
